item.title: Dozens killed in Lebanon as Israel intensifies strikes
item.description: Israel says it struck 100 Hezbollah infrastructure sites and fighters in Lebanon, after PM Benjamin Netanyahu vows to "crush" Hezbollah.

item.title: Three killed and dozens injured in Israeli strike on Gaza City, medics and witnesses say
item.description: Israel says it was targeting a Hamas commander whose predecessor was killed in a similar strike earlier in May.

item.title: Iran condemns US strikes as 'gross violation' of ceasefire
item.description: The attacks took place while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks.

item.title: Can EU find a Russia whisperer to mediate an end to war in Ukraine?
item.description: With the US pulling out of trilateral talks with Russia and Ukraine, the EU is looking for potential candidates to step in.

item.title: Why temperature records are being not only broken but smashed
item.description: The combined effects of a heat dome and climate change have brought extreme warmth to western Europe.
